title: cinnamomum elongatum
intro: Cinnamomum elongatum, commonly known as Indian cassia, is a plant species belonging to the family Lauraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant to protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Cinnamomum elongatum include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include cinnamaldehyde, cinnamic acid, and lignans, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
